title: Rc Capabilities
objective: Implement a machine-readable release capability and provenance report that distinguishes compiled, bundled, declared fallback, unavailable, and cache-presence evidence without triggering builds or claiming unprobed usability.

handoff.summary: Hardened the standalone release capability observation to consume the exact canonical build-manifest validator and expose valid sagejsVersion, source.commit, target, and toolchain.nativeMathProfile identity only. Invalid manifests fail closed without reflecting arbitrary content. Relocated SEA FFI and production-kernel candidates now require a generic immutable size/SHA-256 receipt for every embedded manifest, generated addon, required base addon, kernel index, wrapper, and kernel addon; the exact native-kernel source set and canonical index identity come from buildManifest.capabilities.nativeKernels, never a neighboring checkout. Static fallbacks are declared with availability not-probed, caches report only absent/empty/nonempty plus not-inspected, and SAGEJS_NATIVE_MATH_PROFILE is explicitly a build request. The @native policy model now distinguishes cache discovery from addon loading and exactly covers auto, native, dynamic, javascript, and invalid modes. Thirteen focused tests include byte tampering, missing receipts, manifest identity tampering, conflicting nearby architecture, policy combinations, and conservative cache semantics.
risks: The native-math environment input is a prospective build request, not runtime selection; exact build fingerprints still require the build toolchain probe recorded by release assembly.
Platform behavior is simulated in the focused corpus; integration should exercise the standalone report inside real Linux, Windows, and macOS release artifacts.
The old-base portable tier reaches unrelated missing FLINT artifacts and lacks the integration-owned release test registrations; focused, architecture, and strict-library checks pass.
next_steps: The integration lane must use its existing test/node-test-manifest.cjs registrations and materialized native dependencies to run the complete portable tier.
Wire collectReleaseCapabilities and formatReleaseCapabilities into the public release diagnostics command without changing their observational-only contract.
Release assembly must populate capabilities.embeddedAssets and capabilities.nativeKernels in the canonical build receipt, then retain the reporter JSON beside release checksums and provenance.
